title: Reinforced Fast Weights via Next-Sequence Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2602.16704v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Fast weight architectures offer a promising alternative to standard transformers for long-context modeling by replacing the KV-cache with a recurrently updated fixed-size memory. Despite this architectural shift, they are typically trained with the same next-token prediction (NTP) objective as standard transformers. This creates a mismatch: fast weight models rely on an evolving memory state to support future predictions, while NTP provides only token-level supervision for the immediate next token. We address this mismatch with next-sequence prediction (NSP), a sequence-level extension of NTP that trains models to produce coherent multi-token continuations from their recurrent memory state. translated_title: 通过下一序列预测强化快速权重
translated_abstract: 快速权重（Fast Weight）架构通过用循环更新的固定大小记忆取代KV缓存，为长上下文建模提供了标准Transformer的一种有前景的替代方案。尽管架构发生了这一转变，它们通常仍采用与标准Transformer相同的下一词元预测（NTP）目标进行训练。这造成了不匹配：快速权重模型依赖不断演化的记忆状态来支持未来的预测，而NTP仅为紧接着的下一个词元提供词元级别的监督。我们通过下一序列预测（NSP）来解决这一不匹配问题，NSP是NTP在序列级别的扩展，它训练模型从其循环记忆状态中生成连贯的多词Token延续。为了优化这一序列级目标，我们提出了ReFINE（通过下一序列预测强化快速权重）。ReFINE基于预测熵选择信息量大的词元位置，生成多词元展开序列，并分配序列级奖励……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出下一序列预测（NSP）目标及ReFINE方法，利用强化学习在序列级别优化快速权重模型，解决了传统下一词元预测目标与循环记忆状态之间的训练不匹配问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes next-sequence prediction (NSP) and the ReFINE method, which uses reinforcement learning to optimize fast weight models at the sequence level, resolving the mismatch between the conventional next-token prediction objective and the evolving recurrent memory state.
